cards.Dictionary Meaning (English): the underlying course, order, or guiding principle by which things proceed; in Laozi, especially the fundamental Way that can be followed or lived in
cards.Nuance (English): Here it names the fundamental Way, not the act of speaking.
cards.Register (English): Classical Chinese; especially the Laozi/Wang Bi recension
cards.Sentence Translations (English): The Way that can be spoken of is not the constant Way; the name that can be named is not the constant name.
cards.Sentences: S道可道，非常道，名可名，非常名；

cards.Dictionary Meaning (English): to express in words or describe verbally; to say something aloud or in speech
cards.Nuance (English): Often introduces or frames an utterance, report, or explanation.
cards.Register (English): Classical Chinese; common in received pre-Qin and Han prose
cards.Sentence Translations (English): He spoke of the matter and left.|I do not speak of this matter.|Everyone speaks well of him.|The Laozi states this very clearly.
cards.Sentences: 子道其事而去。|吾不道此言。|人皆道其善。|老子道之甚明。
